name: Bonheur ASA
summary: Bonheur ASA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the renewable energy, wind service, and cruise businesses in the United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Norway, Europe, Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Internationally. The company operates through four segments: Renewable Energy, Wind Service, Cruise, and Other Investments. The Renewable Energy segment develops, constructs, and operates wind farms with an installed capacity of 804.9 megawatts (MW).
